description:
I am a right-handed opening batsman who enjoys taking the initiative during the powerplay by finding boundaries and maintaining a strong scoring rate. Outside the powerplay, I focus on rotating the strike effectively and building partnerships.

As a medium-pace all-rounder, I bring plenty of variations to my bowling and am comfortable bowling in any phase of the game, particularly in pressure situations. I pride myself on being a versatile and reliable option for the team.

Fitness is a major part of my game. I am a fit and energetic all-rounder who enjoys being active on the field, covering ground, and contributing through high-intensity fielding. I bring energy, adaptability, and a team-first mindset to every game.
didYouKnow:
I have had the opportunity to play in international T10 leagues in the Cayman Islands under the captaincy of cricket legend David Warner. I have also shared the field and dressing room with several internationally renowned players, including Carlos Brathwaite, Alex Hales, Beau Webster, George Munsey, Shakib Al Hasan, Thisara Perera, and many other established names in the game.

I have also been part of the Cayman Islands national team training squad, giving me exposure to the international and associate-level cricket environment.

Beyond my playing experience, I have built strong friendships and connections with players from various Associate Nations, giving me a unique perspective on different cricketing cultures, playing styles, and experiences across the global game.
